name: DEPRISION
detailed_description:
You wake up paralyzed in an abandoned place. You can’t move. You can’t scream. You can only watch as twisted shadows slither through the corners of the room. Something is watching. Something is waiting.

Then darkness.

When you regain consciousness, you convince yourself it was just sleep paralysis. A nightmare. But the roar of the storm outside tells a different story. A lightning bolt tears through the sky, followed by a deafening thunderclap that shakes the ground beneath you. You’re not in your bed. You’re in the middle of a forest engulfed in a violent thunderstorm. Rain stabs your skin like needles, and the wind howls through the trees, bending them like paper. You don’t remember how you got here. You don’t remember who you are.

Every flash of lightning reveals twisted figures between the trees. Shadows or something else? The thunder drowns out all sound, but the chill crawling up your spine tells you something is watching.

Your amnesia is your greatest enemy, but soon, it won’t be the only one.

You must find shelter. You must keep moving. But then it happens again. A force grips your body, paralysis takes hold. Only this time, something stirs in the darkness. Something that awakens with every episode, feeding on every crack in your sanity.

Is it real? Or is your mind falling apart?

The truth hides in the storm, buried in the shadows between the trees. You just have to survive long enough to find it.

The revolver is not a weapon—it’s your only way out… or your worst damnation.

Face the horrors of your own mind and wield this unique tool to carve a path through the chaos. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and create pathways that defy reality itself. Every shot could be the key to your escape… or the beginning of an even darker fate.

KEY FEATURES: GAME MECHANICS

🔹1. Revolver – The Cycle Resetter

  • Dual Function: It’s not just a weapon; it’s a cycle resetter, providing moments of safety and advancing the narrative.

  • Defense and Progression: Allows you to defend against certain enemies and escape Alan’s dark thoughts, altering the environment to reveal new paths and secrets.

  • Impact on Reality: Every shot could be the key to escape… or the beginning of an even darker fate.

🔹2. Flashlight – Revealing the Hidden

  • Discovery of Secrets: Illuminates dark areas to reveal objects, clues, and elements invisible to the naked eye.

  • Environmental Interaction: Some areas become accessible or understandable only when hidden details are discovered through light.

🔹3. Shotgun – Advanced Defensive Capabilities

  • Superior Firepower: Provides strong defense against aggressive enemies, essential in critical situations.

  • Upgrade System: Upgrades its features, offering more customization and progression in your arsenal.

🔹4. Healing System – Keep Your Life

  • Medkit Usage: Collect and use medkits to restore health in crucial moments, allowing you to progress despite taking damage.

🔹5. Clock – Time Manipulation and Puzzle Solving

  • Time Distortion: Alters the perception of time, affecting both the environment and the behavior of enemies and events.

  • Puzzle Tool: Essential for unlocking clues, altering scenarios, and solving riddles, adding an extra layer to the gameplay.

🔹6. Hiding System – Strategic Evasion

  • Stealth Mechanics: Hide in places like beds, closets, or behind barrels to avoid detection by enemies.

  • Tension and Survival: Choosing the right place and moment to hide can make the difference between survival and danger.

🔹7. Melee Combat – Direct Confrontation

  • Physical Confrontation: Resort to melee attacks when ammo runs out or the situation demands it.

  • Risk and Reward: This system adds tension, as direct combat can be both an opportunity and a risk.

🔹8. Cycle Reset – Reality Alteration

  • Reset Mechanic: Allows resetting certain game cycles, modifying environments, enemy locations, and available clues.

  • Strategic Planning: Choosing the right moment to activate the reset can be crucial to solving puzzles or escaping critical situations.

🔹9. Inventory System – Comprehensive Resource Management

  • Organization and Use of Resources: Manage ammo, medkits, health points, cards, and other essential items.

  • Tactical Decisions: Carefully plan what to carry and when to use each item, adding a layer of strategic depth to survival.

🔹10. Inspection System – Uncover the Truth

  • Detailed Interaction: Examine objects and environments closely to uncover clues and unravel the mystery of DEPRISION.

  • Puzzle Integration: Crucial for solving riddles that reveal key fragments of the hidden story.

🔹11. Revise Adaptive Intelligence (RAI) – Enemy Behavior

  • Adaptive Enemies: Enemies react dynamically to your actions, offering challenging and unpredictable encounters.

  • Realistic Behavior: NPCs and creatures respond naturally, enhancing the feeling of a hostile, living world.

  • Perception and Reaction: Some enemies can hear noises or detect changes in their environment, following patterns until the player creates enough disturbance to break those patterns and initiate a chase.

🔹12. Body Camera System – Unmatched Realism

  • Unmatched Realism: Experience the game from a first-person perspective with advanced body camera technology, making every movement and moment feel incredibly real.

🔹13. Immersive Horror Experience – Sleep Paralysis and Hallucinations

  • Sleep Paralysis and Hallucinations: Face episodes of sleep paralysis and disturbing hallucinations that blur the line between reality and nightmare.

  • Cinematic Terror: Every encounter challenges your sanity, keeping you on edge.

🔹14. Flicker Mechanic – Intermittent Vision

  • Intermittent Vision: Your vision flickers during critical moments, simulating a loss of control and increasing tension.

🔹15. 8D Audio and Cinematic Sound Design – Auditory Immersion

  • Auditory Immersion: Every whisper, breath, and distant sound is carefully crafted to immerse you in a chilling atmosphere, sending shivers down your spine with every note.

🔹16. Next-Generation Graphics – Stunning Visuals

  • Stunning Visuals: Utilizing technologies like Lumen, Nanite, and Ray Tracing, DEPRISION offers hyper-realistic environments that push the boundaries of indie horror games.

🔹17. Cinematic Mode (Letterbox) – Immersive Experience

  • Immersive Experience: Activate cinematic mode for a more immersive experience, featuring letterboxing (black bars). This option can be toggled on or off to provide either a more cinematic or traditional gameplay view.

🔹18. Innovative Puzzles – Challenging Mental and Environmental Challenges

  • Mental and Environmental Challenges: Solve puzzles that test your wits, manipulating reality and revealing hidden truths that unlock new paths in the game.

🔹19. Time Control – Time Manipulation

  • Manipulate Time: Pause, rewind, or fast-forward time during critical moments to change the course of events.

  • Time-Locked Areas: Some areas can only be accessed when time manipulation is used strategically to unlock paths or progress.

🔹20. Environmental Physics – Interaction with the World

  • Dynamic World Interaction: Objects in the environment react to the player’s actions, including being moved, thrown, or triggered, creating a responsive world.

  • Realistic Physics: Objects fall, break, or react based on realistic physics, influencing both puzzles and combat.

And that’s just the beginning! We’ll be sharing more information in the coming months.

ALAN – A MIND TRAPPED IN MADNESS

Alan is the main protagonist of DEPRISION. Waking up in an unfamiliar and terrifying environment, he is determined to unravel the truth behind his situation. With no memory of how he got there, Alan must explore the desolate and ruined town where he finds himself, searching for clues to his past.

His actions and decisions will shape the story, as he uncovers secrets, interacts with other characters, and faces unspeakable horrors that lurk in the darkness.

MIA – HOPE OR ILLUSION?

Imprisoned in the devastated town of DEPRISION, Mia becomes Alan’s beacon of hope. She holds crucial knowledge about the mysterious virus that plagues DEPRISION and may be the key to saving those trapped in its deadly grip.

As Alan ventures deeper into the nightmare, Mia guides him through the horrors that await, offering insight into the town’s dark past. But as the story unfolds, reality begins to blur.

Is Mia truly real? Or is she just another illusion created by Alan’s fractured mind—a side effect of the virus infecting him? The truth is hidden in the shadows, and only by facing the town’s darkest secrets can Alan uncover the reality… before it’s too late.

THE CURSED TOWN OF DEPRISION

DEPRISION is a desolate and forsaken place—where strange whispers fill the air, creatures lurk in the darkness, and disturbing events unfold.

Few who enter ever return. The town is shrouded in mystery, with rumors of a virus that doesn’t just attack the body—but the mind itself. Fear keeps outsiders away, but those who are trapped within its walls must fight to survive.

Can you escape DEPRISION, or will you succumb to the madness?

MY WORST NIGHTMARE

A dark and ethereal presence lurking in the depths of Alan's mind. This entity emerges in every nightmare, challenging him to face his worst fears and the hidden truth of his past.

Its mere presence is a constant reminder of the price of guilt—a specter that embodies inner torment and the corruption of the soul.

As Alan delves into the dark heart of DEPRISION in search of answers, Mia becomes his guide and confidante, helping him navigate the dangers and challenges lurking around every corner. Her presence gives Alan the determination to confront his own doubts and fears, as well as the hope of finding a way out of this nightmare world.

However, the line between reality and illusion becomes blurred as the story progresses, and Alan is forced to question the true nature of his relationship with Mia. Is she really his wife, or just a creation of his disturbed mind, induced by the virus? Only by unraveling the darkest secrets of DEPRISION can he discover the truth and find a way to save Mia and himself.

The ultimate psychological horror experience you will enjoy, as it will make you feel what amnesia is typically like. You will experience every second firsthand—an immersive experience that will terrify and shake you, providing auditory realism and claustrophobia.

DEPRISION has been conceived with the vision of fully immersing players in a reality that goes beyond the screen. In this game, immersion is key: from facing sleep paralysis to exploring the depths of the mind of a character deeply tormented by amnesia and madness. Every moment revolves around a unique sensory experience.

The narrative is the throbbing heart of DEPRISION, with a protagonist tormented by delusional thoughts, constantly journeying through his own fractured psyche. Every interaction and discovery unlocks a new revelation, leading the player to thrilling twists and turns that defy conventional expectations.

Next-Gen Graphics

DEPRISION pushes visual immersion to the limit with cutting-edge technology, offering a graphical experience that redefines Survival Horror. Every shadow, reflection, and environmental detail has been crafted using the most advanced tools to deliver a hyper-realistic and immersive visual experience.

🔹 Next-Generation Lighting and Shading

  • Real-time Ray Tracing, generating hyper-realistic reflections, shadows, and refractions.

  • Dynamic Global Illumination, with NVIDIA RTX and AMD Radeon RDNA 2/3 technology, naturally recreating light in every scene.

  • Advanced shadow shading, achieving a smooth and realistic transition between light and shadow.

  • Volumetric light rays, traversing spaces and interacting with the environment, enhancing the sense of depth.

🔹 Next-Generation Modeling and Texturing

  • High-quality models, leveraging the power of Nanite, eliminating geometry limitations and achieving ultra-detailed environments.

  • 4K photorealistic textures, applied using Parallax Occlusion Mapping and Subsurface Scattering techniques, for realistic materials like skin, wood, and metal.

  • Hyper-realistic animations and cinematics, with high-precision motion capture.

🔹 Dynamic and Evolving Environments

  • Dynamic destruction and deformation systems, where the environment reacts to the player's actions.

  • Real-time portals and dimensional transitions, altering the perception of space.

  • Advanced simulation of wind and thunderstorms, with impactful lightning and realistic rain that affects visibility and sound.

  • Immersive camera, simulating natural head movement to enhance the sense of presence.

Real-time eye blinking simulation, affecting the perception of light and darkness.

Sound also plays a crucial role in creating DEPRISION eerie atmosphere. Surrounding sounds further immerse you in the game, making every whisper and cream keep you on edge at all times.

🔹 Audio and Physics for Total Immersion

  • 8D sound effects, creating a three-dimensional perception of space, allowing threats to be identified by their sound.

  • Advanced physics, with objects and environment elements reacting realistically to each player action.

  • Particle and fluid simulation, adding an extra level of realism to the atmosphere.

Each of these elements combines to offer an unprecedented visual, auditory, and gameplay experience, elevating psychological horror to a whole new level.

short_description: DEPRISION is a AAA-level survival horror FPS adventure. Follow the story of a man trapped in a parallel dimension after killing his wife, daughter, and himself. Navigate through his mind, explore, gather resources, and fight your way through a mysterious tropical storm controlled by his mind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 6GB | AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT 6GB.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: It should be possible to play at Medium-High quality settings at 70 FPS or at Epic quality settings at 50 FPS in FullHD (without upscaling technologies like "DLSS and FSR" enabled). SSD is recommended.

  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12400F | AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti | AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: It should be possible to play at Epic quality settings at 90 FPS or at Cinematic quality settings at 40 FPS in FullHD (without upscaling technologies like "DLSS and FSR" enabled). SSD is recommended.
